replies.author: Javipepe
replies.body:
Besides it being a bit flat and bare, I quite like the block palette and how the islands are disposed throughout the whole map. With the possible exception of the spawn places, the other islands seem maybe a bit too small. Monument is way to hard to get, consider you'd need to go through the spawn to actually get it.

But with some edits, it could play really well; good job :))
